title: Insulin Pump Program Payment Plan Installment Worksheet
content:
A payment plan the customer accepts on an Insulin Pump Program sets the plan months and the monthly installment as follows, within the base limits on the tier's minimum balance, maximum months and minimum installment.

1. **Program balance.** The program balance is the remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds posted on the program less its payments and balance adjustments.
2. **Standard computation.** In the standard computation the covered balance is the whole program balance and the plan months are the tier's payment-plan maximum months, cut where the covered balance divided by them falls below the tier's minimum installment to the whole number of months at which it is met, rounded down and never fewer than one; the monthly installment is the covered balance divided by those months, rounded up to the cent.
3. **No plan.** No plan is offered where the program balance is below the tier's payment-plan minimum balance, and the installment is then nothing.
4. **Combination.** Any adjustment to these standard figures changes the standard figure it names, replacements before additions and reductions; the plan months are then never more than the tier's payment-plan maximum months and never fewer than one, and where the covered balance divided by them falls below the tier's minimum installment they are cut to the whole number of months at which the minimum installment is met, rounded down and never fewer than one; the monthly installment is the covered balance divided by the plan months, rounded up to the cent, the last installment absorbing the difference.

## Standard computation worked through (hypothetical tier: minimum balance $100.00, maximum 10 months, minimum installment $20.00)

| Line | Balance $250.00 | Balance $150.00 | Balance $90.00 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Program balance at or above the minimum balance? | yes | yes | no — no plan, installment nothing |
| Covered balance | $250.00 | $150.00 | — |
| Covered balance divided by 10 months | $25.00 (meets $20.00) | $15.00 (below $20.00) | — |
| Plan months | 10 | 150 divided by 20 is 7.5, rounded down to 7 | — |
| Monthly installment | $25.00 | 150 divided by 7 is 21.4286, rounded up to $21.43; the last installment absorbs the difference ($21.42) | — |
